headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) Surges 9.3%: Is This an Indication of Further Gains?
headlines.summary: American Tower (AMT) witnessed a jump in share price last session on above-average trading volume. The latest trend in FFO estimate revisions for the stock doesn't suggest further strength down the road.

headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) Stock May Be 43% Undervalued Despite Dividend Focus
headlines.summary: American Tower has seen its share price move around in recent years, and the question now is whether the current valuation lines up with the cash flows its towers and data centers can realistically generate. With the stock closing at US$166.73, investors are asking how much of the future lease income and data center earnings are already baked into that price. Over the past 5 years the share price has fallen 26.

headlines.title: Why American Tower Stock Jumped 8.6% Today
headlines.summary: A SpaceX spectrum deal sent tower stocks soaring and carrier stocks sliding.

headlines.title: Is American Tower (AMT) A Bargain Following Its October 27 Earnings Setup?
headlines.summary: American Tower (AMT) heads into its fiscal Q3 2026 earnings release on October 27 with expectations for funds from operations of $2.78 per diluted share, matching the prior year’s quarter. American Tower’s share price has slipped 4.62% year to date and is down 5.12% over the past month, while a 3.52% 7 day share price return suggests only a modest short term rebound at a current level of $166.73.

headlines.title: Two REITs Yield Over 4%. One Is a Dividend Machine, the Other Is a Gamble
headlines.summary: Two REITs sit within a half-point of each other on yield, but one funds its dividend from locked-in contracts while the other depends on a commodity market that nobody can predict. Choosing the wrong one could quietly wreck a retirement income plan.

description: American Tower Corporation one of the largest global REITs, is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate with a portfolio of over 148,000 communications sites and a highly interconnected footprint of U.S. data center facilities. American Tower Corporation was incorporated in 1995 in Delaware and is based in Massachusetts, Boston.
